about.title: See the work as it happens
paragraphs: DeadPoint Automotive is Michael's shop on Tucker Road. He sends progress photos as he works, so you can see exactly what's being done to your car.
Open on weekends and able to tow your car in, DeadPoint makes it easy to get your car fixed when it fits your schedule.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Michael will get back to you. Or call (360) 558-1036.
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Michael will get back to you soon to set up a time.
